output_list.reason: The vulnerability comes from the fact that the sellPrice and buyPrice are set to the provided arguments and are not modified in any way. This can lead to an infinite loop, as the transaction will always be executed, even if the contract doesn't have the necessary amount of tokens to sell. The buy function will keep on sending tokens to the contract until it receives the maximum allowed amount (~ 2.147.483.647 tokens) of ether, which is more than a normal ethereum transaction can hold, causing the loop. As a result, the contract will be able to hold a massive amount of tokens and will be unable to sell them, effectively devaluing it. The vulnerability is that the sellPrice and buyPrice are not set dynamically, but are provided as arguments. It would be better if the sellPrice and buyPrice were dynamic and could be changed after the initial token issue.
